subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled workaround?
rationale: The implementation surface is small, but this changes default Chrome launch policy and depends on upstream Chrome feature behavior that has not been live-proven on current main.

options.title: Prove, Then Add Defaults
options.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document Operator Control
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add Explicit Config
options.body: Introduce a dedicated model-download suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing `browser.extraArgs` surface is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Prove, Then Add Defaults
recommendation.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on managed browser ownership, the browser-plugin move, and the prior related PR review.
